objective: Expose the canonical non-dimensional overall acquisition performance summary on lifetime, fixed-as-of, single-window, and multi-window reporting surfaces without changing evidence acquisition.

semantics.multiWindowDenominator: each window overall.relationshipCount equals that window matureRelationshipCount
semantics.economics: reuse the already-built attributed economics views
semantics.outcomes: reuse the same durable outcome facts already supplied to the corresponding dimension projection

rules: Lifetime reporting adds overall using its already-loaded relationshipIds, attributed views, and durable outcome facts.
Lifetime empty-cohort reporting invokes the canonical pure overall owner with empty relationshipIds, views, and outcomeFacts while preserving zero evidence reads.
Fixed-as-of reporting adds overall using its existing relationshipIds, as-of attributed views, and asOfEvidence.outcomeFacts.
Single-window reporting adds overall using only mature conversionEvidence.relationshipIds, mature attributed views, and conversionEvidence.outcomeFacts.
Each multi-window curve entry adds its own overall projection using that window's mature relationship IDs, attributed views, and filtered outcome facts.
Existing dimension projection behavior and ordering remain unchanged.
Existing persistence call counts remain unchanged.
No reporting surface rereads facts to build overall.
No overall total is reconstructed from dimension buckets.
Exact rates and acquisition cost per outcome remain owned by INS-004T and its canonical dependencies.
No SQL, schema, persistence mutation, migration execution, currency conversion, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation is introduced.
